notes.title: Check out the unmissable Curve Hidden Gems bundle
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce a new bundle, available to buy now on the Steam storefront! With its combined 40% discount, the Hidden Gems bundle features a whopping 18 classic titles from the Curve back catalogue!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48166/Curve_Games_Hidden_Gems/

Taking in just about every genre you can think of, the Hidden Gems bundle is packed full of fan favourites that are guaranteed to keep everyone entertained over the Christmas holidays and beyond.

Already got some of these classics in your collection? No problem! As with every Steam bundle you won’t pay twice for any of the games you already own, making this the perfect way to round out your Curve collection.

Here’s every game included in the Hidden Gems bundle:

[list]
[*] 10 Second Ninja X - (Platformer)
[*] American Fugitive - (Action / Top-down shooter)
[*] Hotshot Racing - (Racing)
[*] Hue - (Puzzle platformer)
[*] Iron Fisticle - (Top-down shooter)

There’s plenty for everyone in the Hidden Gems bundle, and it’s sure to keep you all nice and busy through these cold winter months!

The Curve Team

notes.title: Curve Games Publisher sale 2024
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/curvepublishersale_2024
][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33019968/30ee8ddf9c6508d9d0668ff16c01acde47fb3e4c.png[/img][/url]

Our 2024 publisher event is here!
 
Grab your virtual hard hat and step into the bustling assembly line: this is where the magic happens, where code and pixels turn ideas into games that captivate millions of players around the world.
 
Take advantage of the best deals we ever offered, check out our new bundles and discover what games we are carefully putting together for the rest of year!

[h1]FOR THE KING II
[/h1]
We’re excited to bring forth this update as our Q1 Quality of Life update. The main focus of this update was to level up the current set of characters skill sets and kits and make certain characters a bit more fun to play. We also have a whole host of global changes - Find skills can now activate on vehicles, we’ve made some changes to how Taunt works, and the dreaded misclick on the overworld costing you focus can now be refunded! 

We’ve also made broad changes to the in-game encyclopedia, reworked tooltips to provide more pertinent information, added a few new settings, squashed a bunch of bugs and smoothed out a few areas of the game. We are once again asking the Kraken to drop more loot. 

[h1]SPACE CREW
[/h1]
Ready for an out-of-this-world adventure? From March 1st to 13th, dive into Space Crew: Legendary Edition for [b]FREE[/b] and keep it forever!

As we gear up for our upcoming release, Badlands Crew, we invite you to join us on a journey across the cosmos.

Take your chance to explore the stars! The offer ends[b] March 13th![/b]
See you among the galaxies! 🚀


[h1]WOBBLY LIFE
[/h1]
We are delighted to announce that Wobbly Life is now available on [url=https://www.nvidia.com/en-gb/geforce-now/how-to-play/]GeForce Now[/url]!

[b]What GeForce Now is:[
[/b]
GeForce Now allows you to play your games seamlessly on all your devices; transforming your laptop, desktop, Mac, TV, phone into the most powerful method of gaming!

[b]What else is going on?
[/b]
We’re continuing to work hard on our next update which is [b]coming soon[/b]! 
The next update will contain translation of the game in new languages, new costumes from the latest community contest and many more surprises on... and underneath… Wobbly Island.
We can’t wait to share more about our next update and we hope you will love it as much as we do! 🐸

notes.title: Curve Games Access Sport Bundle is here! 🎮
notes.content:
Access Sport has launched an esports & gaming campaign to raise funds to make grass roots sport more inclusive! You can sign up here and stream your sports & esports content for rewards https://accesssport.org.uk/streaming-for-sport  

To celebrate we have created our Access Sport Bundle including all our sporting classics: Hotshot Racing, Golf Gang, Pumped BMX+, Pump BMX Pro, Stikbold. 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29043/Curve_Access_Sport_Bundle/

[quote]Access Sport is a UK charity providing opportunities for vulnerable and disabled young people to change their lives through sport and physical activity. We do this by training, equipping and supporting community sports clubs, organisations and volunteers to provide inclusive programmes, unleashing their potential to transform the lives of under-served young people in their local communities.

We work across all sports - team sports such as football, basketball, hockey and rugby, through to sports such as tennis, climbing, yoga, boxing and many more. In some sports, such as BMX Cycling, we have developed whole programmes resulting in new opportunities for tens of thousands of young people. This video explains more: 

[previewyoutube=_MOIu3ExqkY;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_MOIu3ExqkY
[/previewyoutube]
All the games in this sale will be donating a portion of their net profits to Access Sport, so by purchasing games you will be directly helping us give more young people a chance to play sport. 

Access Sport is grateful to all the publishers that have supported this sale, especially the team at Curve Games whose incredible support has enabled us to create this page.

To find out more about how Access Sport works with the video games community and our #streamingforsport campaign which includes the chance for streamers to win an Olympic BMX bike, please visit our website [url=https://www.accesssport.org.uk/video-game-partners]here[/url]. [/quote]

notes.title: Win exclusive prizes with Hotshot Team Rivals
notes.content:
Brand new free Hotshot Racing DLC ‘Big Boss Bundle’ is out now on PC and consoles, featuring colourful new tracks, a new Grand Prix Championship – and brand new game mode, Barrel Barrage!
 
[previewyoutube=wethUHcYFMY;full][/previewyoutube]
Barrel Barrage takes Hotshot Racing’s trademark breakneck speed and add explosive barrels to the mix. Launched from the rear of each vehicle, barrels explode on contact with competitor’s cars, inflicting damage and making each dash for the chequered flag more perilous.
 
To celebrate this explosive new mode, we’re starting Hotshot Team Rivals, a competition that pits Hotshot against Hotshot for the chance to win their own incredible 3D printed car model and trophy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/b2479d99a25f3aaefb3f433bc29825ff6b70baf6.gif[/img]
 
Think you’ve got what it takes? Just follow these simple steps:

[h3]Capture your Barrel Barrage moments[/h3]
Barrel Barrage isn’t short of hectic battles and we want to see the best moments you can muster. Grab a short clip of your most spectacular race via each platform’s recording feature.
 
[h3]Pick a team[/h3]
It’s a rivalry as old as time: Red vs. Blue! But choose your team wisely; once you pick, there’s no going back
 
[h3]Share your clips[/h3]
Join your chosen team by tweeting your clip with either the hashtag #HotshotReds or #HotshotBlues
 
And that’s it! We’ll choose the best clips from each team very soon, and ask the Hotshot community to vote for their favourites. Three racers from our winning team will then receive their awesome Hotshots prizes.

[b]Looking for a race? Jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/curvedigital]Discord[/url] and join a game with our Hotshot community!
[/b] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/7e8c357a74df538065a2068341cc0eb85b923f6f.jpg[/img]
 
But before your begin, take a quick look at our list of rules:
[list]
[*] Barrel Barrage mode must be used in all clips
[*] All clips must be recorded in an online game (feel free to use either Ranked or Public games)
[*] Share as many clips as you like, but only for one team – the first hashtag you use will be counted as your official choice
[*] Entries are limited to players in Europe and North America due to shipping restrictions
[/list]
[b]Have a Hotshot stream planned soon? You can also enter our competition with this! Just share the link to your stream with us on Twitter and use the relevant hashtag[/b]
 
We can’t wait to check out your awesome Barrel Barrage clips. In the meantime, let us know what you think of the Big Boss Bundle on [b][url=https://discord.gg/curvedigital]Discord[/url][/b] and [url=https://twitter.com/curvedigital][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Arcade Driving Perfection: Hotshot Racing is out now!
notes.content:
[h3]Hotshot Racing takes the colourful and iconic arcade racing formula of the 90s and updates it for the modern generation. We're delighted to say it's out right now on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=3glVhkFAcvc;full][/previewyoutube]
Featuring tracks in playfully reimagined locations from across the globe, drivers bursting with personality and an easy to pick up yet hard to master drift-centric gameplay, Hotshot Racing is perfect for anyone who spent their formative years slinging coins into driving games at arcades.

Hotshot Racing’s is available for [b]£15.99 / €19.99 / $19.99[/b] but during the week of launch, prospective racers can purchase the game for [b]20% off that price[/b]. Additionally there are no microtransactions, and we're already working on free post-release downloadable content in the guise of new tracks, a new championship and more! Further details on this new content will be shared in the weeks ahead. Here's a little tease!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/00874e316e87ff139e9302dcaa07eb0c9598a2ca.gif[/img]

Here's a full rundown of everything you can expect from Hotshot Racing:
[list]
[b][*] RACE AROUND THE WORLD[/b]
Hotshot Racing features 16 tracks set across the globe with sharp corners providing technical yet enjoyable challenges. Take in coastal, jungle, alpine and Las Vegas desert environments, with each course modelled with the most vivid colours and blue skies for miles.#

[b][*] PLAY YOUR WAY[/b]
Time Trial and Grand Prix modes cater to those who like to compete in classic racing formats, while ‘Cops and Robbers’ and ‘Drive or Explode’ modes offer exhilarating new ways to play. Smash lap records to rise-up the global online leaderboards or download ghost laps to match your racing lines against the very best.

[b][*] MEET THE HOTSHOTS[/b]
Keiko, Xing, Mike, Alexa, Aston, Toshiro, Marcus and Viktor - eight speed addicts that have dedicated their lives to the pursuit of being the greatest racing driver in the world. Each racer has four unique vehicles which pay homage to some of the most iconic racing cars on the planet.

[b][*] ADDITIONAL RACE TYPES[/b]
In addition to classic single race and championship game modes, Hotshot Racing also features two new signature game modes; Drive or Explode and Cops And Robbers. In Drive or Explode players must keep their vehicle above a minimum speed which continues to increase at regular intervals. Cops And Robbers is an eight-player game mode which casts players as law enforcement or criminals.

Every race completed earns players dollars based on their performance which they can utilise to customise their ride from new chassis components to cockpit ‘improvements’ like furry dice and bobbleheads.

notes.title: Hotshot Racing review - knockabout arcade racing fun
notes.content:
If you've ever enjoyed an arcade racer, I can pretty much guarantee you'll find something to enjoy in Hotshot Racing. Apologies for opening on such a banality, but honestly it's true - and that's partly because there's a little bit of every arcade racer of note in Lucky Mountain Games and Sumo Digital's enjoyable, knockabout medley of all that's great and good about the genre.

There's some of Virtua Racing, Winning Run and those other early 3D pioneers in Hotshot Racing, withs its lo-polygon look that's so sharp you could slice your finger on its hard edges. And this really is a striking thing, both in stills and in motion: commendably, it's 60fps across all platforms, that slickness doing justice to colourful, overstated worlds that feel like the developers have had some of whatever Sega was drinking in its mid-90s heyday. They're upbeat fantasy worlds, presided over by gargantuan statues and speeding under blue, blue skies.

There's a touch more Sega beneath those visuals - a dash of Scud Race in its garage that takes inspiration from real-life legends, a little OutRun in its drifting and drafting, both of which are then used to fill up a multi-stage boost bar that's pure Burnout. The drifting itself takes its cues from Split/Second, with cars quick to break traction and just as happy to snap back into line in what's a very approachable brand of arcade racing. It's incredibly easy to get to grips with, perhaps because this is the sort of thing best experienced with a bunch of rowdy friends in the four-player splitscreen that's on offer.

notes.title: Arcade racers are having a bit of a moment
notes.content:
It's important, I think, to be grateful for what you've got, and as a fan of racing games I can say with some conviction it's rarely been any better than it has right now. The current crisis that saw garages shuttered at racing tracks across the world put the spotlight on sims as drivers looked to get their kicks in the virtual space, and showed us what a fine crop there currently is: there's iRacing, looking as strong as it ever has in its 12 year history, with rFactor 2 finally taking shape as a proper contender too, while console players recently got a chance to sample the delights of Kunos Simulazioni's Assetto Corsa Competizione - and looking beyond that, on console you're spoilt for choice, with F1 going from strength to strength while off-roaders get not just Dirt Rally but also Kylotonn's equally excellent WRC series. What a time to be alive, frankly.

"But!" I hear you ask, "what about the arcade racers?" Well, my friend, have patience and perhaps put a few pennies aside, because they're coming. And they're coming very, very soon.

Next week is set to be one of the most remarkable for the genre since Blur and Split/Second famously clashed at release (and infamously crashed and burned soon after, but I'm hopeful that won't be the case here), with two of the very best arcade racers I've played in the last decade going head-to-head. Hotshot Racing is first up, the hotly-awaited spin on early 90s arcade classics from Lucky Mountain Games releasing on September 10th. A day later and the lesser-known but no less fantastic Inertial Drift from Level 91 and PQube comes out, the game drawing inspiration from late 90s racers and with more than a few twists of its own.

notes.title: Hotshot Racing gets a release date
notes.content:
Hotshot Racing finally has a release date and it's only a few short days away, with the 90s-styled arcade racer from Lucky Mountain Games and Sumo Digital hitting PC, Switch, Xbox One and PlayStation 4 on September 10th.

It marks the end of almost a decade long journey for what was once known as Racing Apex, with the title changing as arcade racing experts Sumo Digital came onboard to help out. It's a fairly expansive thing, with multiplayer for four players in local splitscreen or for eight players online, and with a suite of game modes - oh, and it's 60fps on all platforms (though I'm not sure if that's across all modes).

We'll have a review up for you a couple of days before Hotshot Racing comes out early next month.

notes.title: Blisteringly-fast, retro-inspired 60FPS racer ‘Hotshot Racing’ coming soon
notes.content:
Hotshot Racing channels classic arcade racers sporting colourful polygonal visuals, boost-fuelled drift gameplay and a silky smooth 60 frames per second in the game’s single-player modes regardless of platform.

When we first played Hotshot Racing here at Curve, we were immediately transported to the days of classic arcade racers like Virtua Racing, Crusin’ USA, SEGA Rally and so many more. Check out our brand-new announcement trailer below.

[previewyoutube=Qce9nk7hkYg;full]YOUTUBE[/previewyoutube]

Hotshot Racing is set to emulate and expand upon the classic ‘90s arcade racing game formula featuring eight different hotshot drivers to choose from (each with their own personality and multiple varied four-wheeled rides), 16 personality-filled sun-baked tracks from across the globe, and multiple game modes for players to prove their driving prowess.

It will also feature multiple single-player and multiplayer game modes - both online and offline including 4-player local split-screen co-op.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36924418/256bee5b89d792577865b68188d0d229f2f781a6.gif[/img]

There’s the traditional Grand Prix mode where challengers race on multiple tracks in multi-round championship, Time Trial mode where players complete laps as they wish to seek out the fastest lap time for the online leaderboards, Cops and Robbers mode where the criminals need to evade capture to secure a big cash bonus whereas the police need to take them down, and the Drive or Explode where players need to race to checkpoints to avoid exploding.

[b]Update: A huge thank you to all our fans for waiting so patiently for news on Hotshot Racing’s release. The passion and excitement you’ve shown us so far has been incredible.

We’re getting close to the finish line, but have made the decision to push release back to Summer 2020. We want to ensure we’re giving you the very best racing experience we possibly can come launch day.

Get ready to start your engines on PC and consoles in Summer 2020.[/b]
